about.title: A quiet base for exploring southern Patagonia.
about.paragraph: We are a small family-run hotel in an exceptional location, just a 3-minute walk from the town centre, bars, restaurants and travel agencies. A place that combines simplicity, warmth, comfort and attentive, personalised service.

rooms.title: Double or triple, standard or superior.
rooms.paragraph: 4 room types with heating, Wi-Fi, TV and breakfast included. Choose the one that best suits your trip.

experiences.title: The Perito Moreno glacier, within your reach.
experiences.paragraph: We are your base camp in El Calafate. The hotel arranges transfers and helps you plan every excursion across Patagonia.

whyDirect.title: The best conditions, always on this site.
whyDirect.paragraph: Booking directly with us gives you advantages no intermediary can match.

noIntermediaries.title: No intermediaries
noIntermediaries.text: You deal directly with the hotel, with no surcharges or hidden fees.

support24h.title: 24-hour support
support24h.text: Reception and support every day of the year to help you with anything.

location.title: In the heart of El Calafate.
location.paragraph: Just a 3-minute walk from Av. del Libertador and steps from Lago Argentino. The perfect starting point for the Perito Moreno Glacier and all of southern Patagonia.
